words.note: 當 be known as 只是表示某人、地方、事物的名稱或一般稱呼時，be called 是最自然、最日常的替代表達。
words.example: The small island is called Greenhaven.

exercises.original: The village is known as Pinebrook on local maps.
exercises.zh: 這個村莊在本地地圖上叫作 Pinebrook。
exercises.upgrade: is called · 被稱為；叫作

options.explanation: is called = 叫作。local maps + proper name 表示這是村莊的普通名稱，be called 最直接自然。
is referred to as = 被稱為。也可用，但語氣較正式，這裡只是地名。
is dubbed = 被冠以……稱號。通常帶暱稱、媒體稱號或非正式命名色彩。
goes by = 以……為名。通常用於人所使用的名字或暱稱，不如 be called 適合村莊正式名稱。
is designated as = 被指定為。表示官方分類或用途，不是單純名稱。
is labeled as = 被標籤為。常帶分類或評價意味，不是地名。

exercises.original: This tool is known as the 'layer mask' in the software menu.
exercises.zh: 這個工具在軟件選單中叫作「layer mask」。
exercises.upgrade: is called · 被稱為；叫作

options.explanation: is dubbed = 被冠名。通常有另取暱稱或稱號的意味，不是介面正式名稱。
is called = 叫作。software menu 中的功能名稱就是最典型的 be called。
goes by = 以……為名。較常用於人或非正式名稱。
is designated as = 被指定為。偏分類或官方用途。
is labeled as = 被標示為。若重點是介面文字標籤可用，但這句說的是工具名稱本身。
is described as = 被描述為。表示性質描述，不是名稱。

exercises.original: The mountain is known as Mount Arlen in English.
exercises.zh: 這座山在英語中叫作 Mount Arlen。
exercises.upgrade: is called · 被稱為；叫作

options.explanation: is called = 叫作。in English 明確是在說名稱。
is labeled as = 被標示為。可指地圖標籤，但不是一般名稱表達。
is designated as = 被指定為。通常用於官方分類。
is dubbed = 被冠以稱號。太像暱稱。
goes by = 以……為名。對山名較口語、不如 be called 自然。
is described as = 被描述為。不是命名。

words.note: 較正式，表示在文章、專業討論或特定語境中，人們使用某個名稱或術語來指稱某人或某物。
words.example: This stage is referred to as the recovery phase.
words.exampleZh: 這個階段被稱為恢復期。

exercises.original: In the report, this period is known as the recovery phase.
exercises.zh: 在報告中，這個時期被稱為恢復期。
exercises.upgrade: is referred to as · 被稱作；被稱為

options.explanation: is called casually = 口語稱作。題目有 in the report，正式書面語不需要 casually。
is referred to as = 被稱為。report + technical phase 是典型正式術語指稱。
goes by = 以……為名。較口語，也常指人名。
is dubbed = 被冠以稱號。帶另取稱號意味，不如正式術語自然。
is named after = 以……命名。需要後面是某人或某事物的名字來源。
is labeled negatively as = 被負面標籤為。題目沒有負面評價。

exercises.original: The process is known as 'cold rolling' in engineering textbooks.
exercises.zh: 這個過程在工程教科書中被稱為「cold rolling」。
exercises.upgrade: is referred to as · 被稱作；被稱為

options.explanation: is dubbed = 被冠名。較像媒體或非正式稱號。
is referred to as = 被稱作。engineering textbooks 明確是專業術語語境。
is called by nickname = 以暱稱叫作。不是暱稱。
goes by = 以……為名。較口語。
is designated as = 被指定為。偏官方分類。
is branded as = 被塑造成／被品牌化為。不是術語名稱。

exercises.original: In legal documents, the first party is known as the 'seller'.
exercises.zh: 在法律文件中，第一方被稱為「賣方」。
exercises.upgrade: is referred to as · 被稱作；被稱為

options.explanation: is referred to as = 被稱為。legal documents 是最典型的正式指稱語境。
goes by = 以……為名。太口語。
is dubbed = 被冠稱號。不是另加稱號。
is named after = 以……命名。seller 不是名稱來源。
is nicknamed = 被取暱稱。法律角色不是暱稱。
is styled informally as = 非正式稱作。和 legal documents 的正式性相反。

words.note: 當 be known as 強調正式命名、取名或名稱本身時，可用 be named。常見於建築、計劃、船隻、產品或人名。
words.example: The new research center was named Aurora.
words.exampleZh: 新的研究中心被命名為 Aurora。

exercises.original: The new building will be known as Horizon Hall when it opens.
exercises.zh: 這座新大樓開幕後將命名為 Horizon Hall。
exercises.upgrade: will be named · 被命名為；名字是

options.explanation: will be named = 將被命名為。new building + when it opens 表示正式命名。
will be referred to as = 將被稱為。也可，但不如 named 強調命名行為。
will be dubbed = 將被冠以稱號。較像暱稱或媒體稱號。
will go by = 將以……為名。較口語，也少用於正式建築命名。
will be labeled as = 將被標記為。偏分類或評價。
will be described as = 將被描述為。不是名稱。

exercises.original: The ship is known as Aurora after the explorer's daughter.
exercises.zh: 這艘船以探險家的女兒之名命名為 Aurora。
exercises.upgrade: is named · 被命名為；名字是

options.explanation: is called = 叫作。可說名稱，但 after the explorer's daughter 明確涉及命名來源，因此 named 更精準。
is named = 被命名為。named X after Y 是固定結構。
is dubbed = 被冠名。沒有非正式稱號意味。
is referred to as = 被稱為。不能突出以某人命名。
goes by = 以……為名。較常用於人。
is designated as = 被指定為。不是命名來源。

exercises.original: The scholarship is known as the Rivera Award in honor of its founder.
exercises.zh: 這項獎學金為紀念創辦人而命名為 Rivera Award。
exercises.upgrade: is named · 被命名為；名字是

options.explanation: is named = 被命名為。in honor of its founder 明確是正式命名。
is dubbed = 被冠以稱號。通常較非正式。
goes by = 以……為名。可理解但不夠正式。
is labeled as = 被標籤為。不是名稱由來。
is categorized as = 被分類為。無關。
is described as = 被描述為。不是命名。

words.note: 較口語，常指某人平常使用某個名字、暱稱、簡稱或別名，而不一定是法律姓名。
words.example: Her full name is Katherine, but she goes by Kate.
words.exampleZh: 她全名是 Katherine，但平時叫 Kate。

exercises.original: His legal name is Jonathan, but he is known as Jon among friends and colleagues.
exercises.zh: 他的法定姓名是 Jonathan，但朋友和同事平時都叫他 Jon。
exercises.upgrade: goes by · 以……為名；通常叫作

options.explanation: goes by = 平時以……為名。legal name... but... among friends 是典型常用名／簡稱語境。
is named = 名字是。會和 legal name Jonathan 衝突，不能表達他平常使用 Jon。
is designated as = 被指定為。不是人名使用方式。
is labeled as = 被標籤為。通常是分類或評價。
is referred to formally as = 正式稱為。Jon 反而是非正式簡稱。
is described as = 被描述為。不是名字。

exercises.original: She is known as Mia professionally, although her full first name is Amelia.
exercises.zh: 她在工作上以 Mia 為名，雖然全名是 Amelia。
exercises.upgrade: goes by · 以……為名；通常叫作

options.explanation: is called legally = 法律上叫作。題目反而說 full first name is Amelia。
goes by = 以……為名。professionally + different full name 明確表示常用名。
is dubbed = 被冠暱稱。可像暱稱，但不如 goes by 自然表示日常使用。
is designated as = 被指定為。不是名字。
is labeled as = 被標籤為。無關。
is named after = 以……命名。需要名字來源。

exercises.original: The musician is known as 'Nova' on stage, though that is not her legal name.
exercises.zh: 這位音樂人在台上以「Nova」為名，但那不是她的法定姓名。
exercises.upgrade: goes by · 以……為名；通常叫作

options.explanation: goes by = 以……為名。stage name + not legal name 是典型用法。
is designated as = 被指定為。不是使用藝名。
is categorized as = 被分類為。不是名稱。
is labeled as = 被標籤為。不是日常／舞台稱呼。
is described as = 被描述為。無關。
is named after = 以……命名。沒有命名來源。

words.note: 表示媒體、公眾或某群體給某人或某物一個引人注目的稱號、別名或綽號。通常不是正式名稱。
words.example: The bridge was dubbed the 'Ribbon of Light' by local newspapers.
words.exampleZh: 本地報章把這座橋稱為「光之絲帶」。

exercises.original: The newspapers say the new tower is known as the 'Glass Needle' because of its shape.
exercises.zh: 報章因這座新塔的外形，把它冠以「Glass Needle」的稱號。
exercises.upgrade: is dubbed · 被冠以……稱號；被稱為

options.explanation: is dubbed = 被冠以稱號。newspapers + descriptive nickname because of shape 是典型 dubbed 語境。
is named officially = 正式命名為。題目沒有官方命名，反而是報章稱號。
goes by legally = 法律上以……為名。完全不合。
is designated as = 被指定為。偏官方類別。
is categorized as = 被分類為。不是稱號。

options.text: is referred to in contracts as
options.explanation: is referred to in contracts as = 合約中稱為。語境錯誤。

exercises.original: Fans know the athlete as 'The Rocket' because of his speed.
exercises.zh: 球迷因這名運動員速度快，而稱他為「The Rocket」。
exercises.upgrade: dub him · 被冠以……稱號；被稱為

options.explanation: refer to him formally as = 正式稱他為。粉絲給的綽號不是正式稱呼。
dub him = 給他冠以稱號。The Rocket + because of his speed 是典型綽號。
name him after = 以……命名。不是名字來源。
designate him as = 指定他為。通常接職位或角色。
label him medically as = 醫學標籤。完全不合。
classify him as = 把他分類為。不是暱稱。

exercises.original: Critics know the unusually small car as the 'Pocket Rocket'.
exercises.zh: 評論者把這輛異常小巧的汽車冠以「Pocket Rocket」的稱號。
exercises.upgrade: dub · 被冠以……稱號；被稱為

options.explanation: dub = 冠以稱號。評論者給車一個有趣稱號，非常自然。
designate = 指定。較官方，通常接類別或用途。
name after = 以……命名。需要名稱來源。
categorize = 分類。不是綽號。
describe technically as = 技術描述為。Pocket Rocket 是暱稱，不是技術描述。
register as = 登記為。無關。

words.note: 當 be known as 的語境其實是官方把某人、地方、區域或項目定為某種身份、用途或類別時，可用 be designated as。它不是普通命名，而是正式指定。
words.example: The area was designated as a protected zone.

exercises.original: The land is known as a protected area under the new planning rules.
exercises.zh: 根據新規劃規則，這片土地被指定為保護區。
exercises.upgrade: is designated as · 被指定為；被正式定為

options.explanation: is designated as = 被指定為。under the new planning rules 明確是官方法律／規劃分類。
is called = 被叫作。太一般，不能表達官方指定。
goes by = 以……為名。不是名稱。
is dubbed = 被冠以稱號。過於非正式。
is named after = 以……命名。完全不同。
is nicknamed = 被取暱稱。不是規劃身份。

exercises.original: The room is known as an emergency shelter during severe storms.
exercises.zh: 在嚴重風暴期間，這個房間被正式指定為緊急避難所。
exercises.upgrade: is designated as · 被指定為；被正式定為

options.explanation: is called informally = 非正式稱作。題目是用途指定，不是暱稱。
is designated as = 被指定為。emergency shelter 是官方／功能用途。
goes by = 以……為名。不是名稱。
is dubbed = 被冠稱號。無關。
is named = 被命名。shelter 是功能身份，不是專有名。
is described casually as = 隨意描述為。不能表達正式用途。

exercises.original: Under the policy, the senior nurse is known as the emergency coordinator during a major incident.
exercises.zh: 根據政策，在重大事故期間，高級護士被指定為緊急協調員。
exercises.upgrade: is designated as · 被指定為；被正式定為

options.explanation: is designated as = 被指定為。under the policy + coordinator 是正式角色指派。
is nicknamed = 被取暱稱。不是職務。
goes by = 以……為名。不是角色。
is called socially = 社交上稱作。無關。
is dubbed = 被冠稱號。太非正式。
is named after = 以……命名。無關。

words.note: 當 be known as 表示別人把某人或某事歸入某一類、貼上某種標籤或評價時，可用 be labeled as。常帶簡化、評價甚至負面色彩。
words.example: The proposal was labeled as too risky by several reviewers.
words.exampleZh: 幾名評審把這項提案標籤為風險過高。

exercises.original: The idea became known as unrealistic by critics before the trial had even begun.
exercises.zh: 試驗尚未開始，評論者便把這個構想標籤為不切實際。
exercises.upgrade: was labeled as · 被標籤為；被歸類為

options.explanation: was labeled as = 被標籤為。critics + unrealistic 是評價性分類，而不是名稱。
was named = 被命名。unrealistic 不是名字。
went by = 以……為名。不能接形容詞作常用名。
was dubbed with a nickname = 被冠暱稱。這不是暱稱。
was designated as = 被指定為。通常是正式身份／用途，而不是評論者評價。
was called by title = 以職稱稱呼。無關。

exercises.original: The neighborhood is sometimes known as unsafe by people who have never visited it.
exercises.zh: 有些從未到訪的人有時會把這個社區標籤為不安全。
exercises.upgrade: is labeled as · 被標籤為；被歸類為

options.explanation: is referred to neutrally as = 中性地稱作。unsafe 是評價，不是中性稱呼。
is labeled as = 被標籤為。people who have never visited it 暗示這是簡化甚至不公平的標籤。
is named = 被命名。unsafe 不是名稱。
goes by = 以……為名。無關。
is designated as = 被指定為。不是官方安全分類。

options.text: is dubbed with a proper name
options.explanation: is dubbed with a proper name = 被冠專名。不是暱稱。

exercises.original: Students who ask many questions are sometimes known as difficult, even when they are simply curious.
exercises.zh: 經常提問的學生有時會被標籤為難相處，即使他們只是好奇。
exercises.upgrade: are labeled as · 被標籤為；被歸類為

options.explanation: are labeled as = 被標籤為。difficult 是對人的評價性標籤，而且後半句暗示這種標籤可能不公平。
are named = 被命名。difficult 不是名字。
go by = 以……為名。無關。
are designated as = 被指定為。太官方，也不適合這種評價。
are called by legal name = 以法定姓名稱呼。無關。
are named after = 以……命名。無關。

words.note: 當 be known as 不只是『叫作』，而是表示某人或某物因成就、地位或特徵而被廣泛承認為某種身份時，可用 be recognized as。
words.example: She is recognized as a leading expert in the field.
words.exampleZh: 她被公認為該領域的頂尖專家。

exercises.original: She is known as one of the leading experts in marine conservation because of decades of research.
exercises.zh: 她因數十年的研究而被公認為海洋保育領域的頂尖專家之一。
exercises.upgrade: is recognized as · 被公認為；被認定為

options.explanation: is recognized as = 被公認為。decades of research + leading expert 表示這是專業地位獲廣泛承認，不只是稱呼。
is called = 被叫作。太像名稱，不足以表達專業認可。
goes by = 以……為名。不是名字。
is named = 被命名。expert 是身份評價，不是專名。
is dubbed = 被冠稱號。較像媒體稱號。
is labeled as = 被標籤為。可帶負面或簡化意味，不如 recognized 表達正面專業認可。

exercises.original: The building is known as an important example of early modern architecture by historians.
exercises.zh: 歷史學家公認這座建築是早期現代建築的重要例子。
exercises.upgrade: is recognized as · 被公認為；被認定為

options.explanation: is referred to as = 被稱為。可以描述術語用法，但 by historians + important example 更像專業認定。
is recognized as = 被公認為。表示其地位獲歷史學者承認。
is named = 被命名。不是名字。
goes by = 以……為名。無關。
is dubbed = 被冠稱號。太非正式。
is designated legally as = 法律上指定為。題目是學術評價，不是法律身份。

exercises.original: The university is known as a major center for climate research because of its long publication record.
exercises.zh: 這所大學因長期研究成果而被公認為氣候研究的重要中心。
exercises.upgrade: is recognized as · 被公認為；被認定為

options.explanation: is recognized as = 被公認為。long publication record 表示地位建立在成就與廣泛認可上。
is called = 被叫作。太像名稱。
is named = 被命名。不是專有名。
goes by = 以……為名。無關。
is labeled casually as = 隨意標籤為。與學術認可相反。
is dubbed = 被冠稱號。較像媒體暱稱。

falseSynonyms.zh: 知道；認識不等於一般的 be known as know = 知道；認識 know 是主動動詞，表示某人知道資訊或認識某人；be known as 才表示『被稱為／以……聞名』。兩者語法和意思不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON I know the answer. The place is known as Greenhaven.

falseSynonyms.zh: 認出；辨認不等於一般的 be known as recognize = 認出；辨認 recognize 表示見到某人或某物時能辨認出來。只有 be recognized as 才可在某些語境表示『被公認為』。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON I recognize her face. She is recognized as an expert.

falseSynonyms.zh: 以……命名不等於一般的 be known as name after = 以……命名 name A after B 表示 A 的名稱來自 B。這和一般『叫作甚麼』不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The school was named after its founder.

falseSynonyms.zh: 暱稱不等於一般的 be known as nickname = 暱稱 nickname 是名詞或動詞，專指非正式暱稱；be known as 可以是正式名稱、職稱、術語或聲譽，不只暱稱。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON His nickname is Sam. He is known as a careful editor.

falseSynonyms.zh: 稱號；職銜；標題不等於一般的 be known as title = 稱號；職銜；標題 title 是名稱或職銜本身，不是『被稱為』這個動作。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Director is her title. She is referred to as the director.

falseSynonyms.zh: 著名的不等於一般的 be known as famous = 著名的 famous 表示廣為人知。be known as 主要說明『以甚麼名稱／身份被人知道』，兩者不能普遍互換。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She is famous. She is known as Dr. Lee.

falseSynonyms.zh: 以……聞名不等於一般的 be known as known for = 以……聞名 be known for 後面通常接成就、特徵或原因；be known as 後面通常接名稱、身份或稱號。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The town is known for its beaches. It is known as Seabrook.

falseSynonyms.zh: 為……所知；某人知道不等於一般的 be known as known to = 為……所知；某人知道 be known to 表示某事為某人所知，或某人被某群體認識；它和 be known as 的『被稱為』結構不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The problem is known to experts. The process is known as annealing.
